Improving GAAP gross margins at model labs would weaken cash-burn stress.
Cash burn falling below 30% of revenue would weaken the thesis.
Capex to operating cash flow stabilising below 35% would weaken capex-overbuild stress.
Rising incremental AI gross profit per cumulative AI capex would falsify overbuild risk.
